title: Bridging
intro: Bridge domains switch frames between their member interfaces; a loopback BVI routes for the domain. Cross-connects forward everything received on one interface to another. Membership, split horizon and VLAN tag rewrite are set per interface; changes go to the candidate and apply on commit.
readonly: Your role cannot edit the configuration
nameExists: A record with this name exists
unavailable: The agent does not report bridge-domain state yet

domain.addHelp: Name the bridge domain; its VPP id (1–16777215) is set in the form. Tunnels attach by this id.
domain.noMembers: No interface is a member yet.
domain.macsHelp: The L2 FIB as VPP holds it (learned and static entries), paged by the server.

xc.rxHelp: Every frame (L2) or packet (L3) received here is forwarded; one direction per record

mf.intro: Devices are admitted or blocked by source MAC on interfaces that have the MAC filter switched on (member form). Times use VPP's mactime clock (start-up setting mactime timezone_offset, default UTC−5 with US daylight saving).
mf.enabledNone: The filter is not switched on for any interface.

bridgeDomain.title: Bridge domain
bridgeDomain.help: Bridge domain this interface is a member of; empty = not bridged

shg.title: Split-horizon group
shg.help: 0 = none; members of the same group never forward to each other

bvi.title: BVI
bvi.help: The routed port of the bridge domain: a loopback, one per domain

uuFwd.title: Unknown-unicast forwarder
uuFwd.help: Send unknown-unicast frames to this member only

tagRewrite.title: VLAN tag rewrite
tagRewrite.help: On a bridge member or an L2 cross-connect receive side

macFilter.title: Time-range MAC filter
macFilter.help: Run the MAC filter on frames received here (parent interfaces only)

id.title: Bridge-domain ID
id.help: VPP id 1–16777215; tunnels reference the domain by this number

flood.title: Flood
flood.help: Flood broadcast and multicast frames to all members

uuFlood.title: Unknown-unicast flood
uuFlood.help: Flood frames whose destination MAC is not learned

arpTerm.title: ARP termination
arpTerm.help: Answer ARP requests from the bridge ARP table

tx.title: Send to
tx.help: Interface every frame received on the key interface is sent out of

ipv4Paths.title: IPv4 paths
ipv4Paths.help: Every IPv4 packet received on the interface is forwarded via these paths

action.title: Action
action.help: allow = admit only inside the ranges; drop = block inside the ranges (always, without ranges)
